## Summary

Describe the user or data problem and the implemented solution.

## Verification

- [ ] Frontend lint, type check, tests, and build pass
- [ ] Backend and pipeline tests pass
- [ ] dbt model grain and quality tests are updated when relevant
- [ ] Only synthetic data is included
- [ ] Metric formula, unit, assumptions, limitations, and lineage are documented
- [ ] German UI copy and responsive/reduced-motion behavior were considered

## Risk and rollback

Describe migrations, data backfills, compatibility impact, and a safe rollback.

## Screenshots or API examples

Add focused evidence when the visible behavior or contract changed. Do not
include personal health data, tokens, or secrets.
